classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding sides in nested similar triangles, solve for the inscribed square's side and compare areas, including a general algebraic case.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In the right-angled triangle $ABC$ is a square $BDEF$ as shown in the diagram.

spec.description: Right triangle ABC with an inscribed square BDEF; DE and EF each labelled x cm. External arrows label AB as 12 cm and BC as 9 cm. Ordinary source-blue edges are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: AB=12, BC=9, angle ABC=90 degrees; D lies on AB, E on AC and F on BC; BDEF is a square.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no calculated side length is labelled.

children.label: i
children.prompt: Why is $\triangle EFC$ similar to $\triangle ABC$?

answer.short: $\triangle EFC\sim\triangle ABC$ (AAA): both have a right angle and share the angle at $C$.
answer.worked: $\angle EFC=\angle ABC=90^\circ$ and $\angle ECF=\angle ACB$ because the angle at $C$ is common. The remaining angles are therefore equal, so $\triangle EFC\sim\triangle ABC$ (AAA).

answer.short:
$x=\dfrac{36}{7}=5\dfrac17$.

Use corresponding sides of the similar triangles.
answer.worked:
Since $BF=x$ cm, $FC=(9-x)$ cm. Using corresponding sides:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{EF}{AB}&=\frac{FC}{BC}\\\frac{x}{12}&=\frac{9-x}{9}\\9x&=108-12x\\21x&=108\\x&=\frac{36}{7}.\end{align*}$$

children.label: iii
children.prompt: Hence, find the area of the square $BDEF$ as a percentage of the area of $\triangle ABC$, correct to 1 decimal place.

children.label: b
children.prompt: In this diagram, the square $BDEF$ is inside $\triangle ABC$ as shown. If $BC=x$ cm, $EF=y$ cm and $AB=2BC$:

spec.description: Right triangle ABC with square BDEF inside it; DE and EF each labelled y cm and an external vertical arrow labels BC as x cm. Ordinary source-blue edges are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: AB=2BC, BC=x, DE=EF=y; D lies on AB, E on AC and F on BC; angle ABC=90 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original symbolic givens are labelled.

answer.short:
$x=\dfrac{3y}{2}$, equivalently $y=\dfrac{2x}{3}$.

Use corresponding sides of the similar triangles.
answer.worked:
$AB=2x$ cm and $FC=(x-y)$ cm. As in part a, $\triangle EFC\sim\triangle ABC$ (AAA).
$$\begin{align*}\frac{EF}{AB}&=\frac{FC}{BC}\\\frac{y}{2x}&=\frac{x-y}{x}\\y&=2x-2y\\3y&=2x\\x&=\frac{3y}{2}.\end{align*}$$
